metadata.title: The Secret Second Family
metadata.subtitle: Sorting Dad's hospital bag, I found a tuition bill for a 10-year-old boy—paid from Mom's trust fund.

nodes.text: 09:30 PM · ICU Waiting Room. Father is sedated after his stroke. His spare phone buzzes inside his coat.
Darling, why did Leo’s international school tuition bounce? You promised the villa deed would be signed before Friday!
Grace, I’m holding Dad’s second phone. Who is Sofia? And why is she paying a 10-year-old’s school out of Mom’s trust?!
Oh no... Dad made me swear never to tell you about Sofia until after Mom’s trust closed!
Put the phone down, Riley! Let’s not stress Mom while Dad is in the ICU!

nodes.transcript: [cold, smug] Oh, hello Riley. Since you're reading his messages—I'm already in the hospital lobby with a notarized Power of Attorney. Your mother's reign is over.

nodes.prompt: Sofia is heading up the elevator to ICU Floor 5. What do you do?

options.label: Alert Dr. Lin to restrict ICU access
options.player_reply_text: Dr. Lin, an unauthorized woman is coming up claiming Power of Attorney. Immediate family only!

options.label: Freeze Mom’s trust & pull bank logs
options.player_reply_text: Calling the trust officer right now. Not another dollar leaves Mom’s estate.

nodes.text: Security notified. Also, your father has been cognitively impaired since 4 PM—any document signed today is legally void.
TRUST FROZEN: You discover $340,000 was drained from Mom’s account over 6 years—using a co-signature forged by your sister Grace!
Riley wait! Dad promised he’d pay Mom back after the merger! Don’t tell Mom I helped him!
Tell security to step aside, Riley. Or I call every journalist in town and tell them who your father really is.

nodes.headline: Showdown Outside the ICU
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: Sofia waves her Power of Attorney at the ICU doors—until Mom steps out of the elevator behind her.

nodes.text: 09:48 PM · 5th Floor Corridor. Sofia stands face-to-face with you, holding a manila folder.
Give me the villa keys and settle my son’s trust, and we disappear quietly. Refuse, and your family name is ruined.
Interesting blackmail. Especially since Dr. Lin just certified Dad was unconscious when that paper was dated.
Call the notary! Tell him to backdate the stamp to yesterday morning!!

nodes.transcript: [firm] Ma’am, hospital security is escorting you off the premises. Any attempt to forge medical timelines will be reported to police.

nodes.prompt: Sofia’s lawyer backs away. What do you do about the stolen trust?

options.label: File a clawback suit for Mom’s $340K
options.player_reply_text: Every cent you received came from my mother’s separate trust. Expect a lawsuit Monday.

options.label: Remove Grace as co-trustee tonight
options.player_reply_text: And Grace—sign over your trustee seat tonight, or Mom sees the forged withdrawal slips.

nodes.text: Sofia turns pale and retreats into the elevator. Your mother squeezes your hand from behind.
TRUST SECURED: Grace signs away her trustee power in tears. You are now sole protector of your mother’s estate.
I’m sorry, Riley. I was terrified Dad would cut me off if I said no.
Nobody steals from Mom again. Not Sofia, not Dad, not anyone.

nodes.headline: The House Always Remembers
nodes.teaser_text: Inside the ICU, Father opens his eyes for the first time—and whispers a name that isn’t Mom’s and isn’t Sofia’s.

nodes.text: 11:20 PM · Hospital ICU Corridor. The name Dad just whispered—"Claire"—echoes in your ears.
Riley, who is Claire?! That’s not Mom’s name and it’s not Sofia’s name!
Wait—check the monthly trust withdrawals we pulled from Mom’s account. Every single payment went through Sofia’s name, right?

nodes.caption: TRUST AUDIT · $8,500/mo from Mom’s trust → Sofia’s account → Immediately forwarded to "Claire M. Care Trust".

nodes.text: Your father’s vitals are stabilizing—he’ll be able to speak clearly by morning. Please keep arguments outside the ICU.
If they find out Claire is their mother’s own niece, my cut is over—

nodes.transcript: [gasping] Riley! Did you see what Sofia just unsent?! Wait—Mom had a younger sister who died in a car crash ten years ago! Her daughter’s name was Claire!

nodes.prompt: Sofia was skimming half the money meant for your orphaned cousin! How do you confront her?

options.label: Confront Sofia with the forwarding trail
options.player_reply_text: Sofia, you weren’t Dad’s secret wife—you were the caretaker he hired for our cousin, and you skimmed $4,000 a month!

options.label: Freeze Sofia’s trust access + notify security
options.player_reply_text: Grace, call the trust officer to revoke Sofia’s disbursement card—and ask Dr. Lin to alert hospital security!

nodes.text: SOFIA CRACKS: Her typing bubbles start and stop three times before she bolts toward the hospital elevator.
LOCKED DOWN: Sofia’s bank card declines at the ATM downstairs as hospital security detains her for stealing Dad’s wallet.
Your father swore me to secrecy! He didn’t want your mom’s family fighting over the trust—and I deserved a management fee!
Taking $400,000 over ten years while putting our cousin in a cheap boarding school isn’t a "fee," Sofia—it’s embezzlement!

nodes.headline: The Real Reason Dad Hid It
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: Wait until dawn when Father wakes up—and Sofia tries one last lie about paternity.

nodes.text: 6:40 AM · ICU Waiting Room. Sofia returns with a smug lawyer before Father’s morning checkup.
Think carefully before you sue me. The 10-year-old boy on that tuition bill IS your father’s biological son—and I’m his legal guardian!
First you said you were a caretaker, now you claim the boy is Dad’s son? Which lie is it, Sofia?
Your father is awake and lucid now. He heard the commotion and explicitly asked for ONLY Riley and Grace inside.
If the old man tells them my lawyer forged that guardianship paper—
Dad just squeezed my hand and told me everything! The boy is Claire’s son—Mom’s grand-nephew—and Dad has a sealed DNA report in his safe proving Sofia has ZERO blood tie to him!

nodes.transcript: [monitor beeping steadily] Your father also signed a medical-capacity witness form with me—so any power of attorney Sofia waves around is 100% void.

nodes.prompt: Sofia’s lawyer demands to enter the ICU! How do you shut them down?

options.label: Have Dr. Lin bar them from the ICU floor
options.player_reply_text: Dr. Lin, please enforce Father’s visitor restriction—and send for the estate attorney.

options.label: Send Grace for Dad’s sealed DNA report
options.player_reply_text: Grace, take Dad’s safe code and bring the sealed clinic DNA report—let’s end Sofia’s guardianship scam today!

nodes.text: BARRED AT THE DOOR: Security escorts Sofia and her lawyer out of the ICU wing immediately.
EVIDENCE IN HAND: Within thirty minutes, Grace returns with the sealed clinic dossier and every stolen invoice.
Rest easy, Dad. Grace and I will take care of our little nephew—and get every dollar back.
You can’t prove a thing! My name is still on the guardianship registry!

nodes.headline: The Clinic File Opens
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: Unseal the DNA report in front of Family Services and strip Sofia of every stolen cent.

nodes.text: 2:00 PM · Hospital Conference Room. A Family Services officer sits across from Sofia and your family.
Officer, here is the sealed DNA verification from St. Mary’s Clinic—plus ten years of skimmed trust transfers.

nodes.caption: CLINIC DNA REPORT · 0.00% match to Father & Sofia — 99.9% maternal kin to Mother’s late sister Claire.

nodes.text: My lawyer told me to say that—I didn’t know you had a lab test!
You lied to a dying man’s daughters and stole from an orphan child. Your lawyer already walked out two minutes ago.
If I return the remaining $180,000 in my savings maybe they won’t arrest me—

nodes.transcript: [gentle smile] Good news from Room 402—your father’s blood pressure is normal for the first time all week. He’s ready to welcome the boy home.

nodes.prompt: Family Services revokes Sofia’s guardianship immediately. What do you do next?

options.label: File full restitution & welcome Leo home
options.player_reply_text: Press full restitution charges against Sofia—and Grace and I will co-sign guardianship for our little cousin today.

options.label: Freeze her assets + double his college fund
options.player_reply_text: Attach a court lien to Sofia’s condo to recover every stolen cent—and put 100% into a locked education trust for him!

nodes.text: GUARDIANSHIP TRANSFERRED: Sofia is led out for fraud processing while your family’s long secret heals.
FUTURE GUARANTEED: The judge approves the asset lien on the spot—securing the boy’s education through university.
I can’t believe we almost hated Dad over a misunderstanding that Sofia exploited for ten years.
Truth hurts for an hour—lies hurt for a lifetime. Let’s go see Dad.

nodes.headline: A Family Made Whole
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Finale): Bring Dad home from the hospital and welcome your little cousin into the family.

nodes.text: Two Weeks Later · Family Dining Room. Dad is home from the hospital, smiling over a warm Sunday table.
Look at him showing Dad his math trophy! He’s been smiling nonstop since we brought him home.
Mom’s trust fund is finally doing exactly what she would have wanted—protecting family.
Checking in on my favorite patient! Tell your father to keep taking his blood-pressure meds and no more secret stress!
My court date is next month, I really ruined everything—

nodes.transcript: [laughter around table] Dad just told me to put you on speaker—he says you’re officially the Trustee of Mom’s legacy now, Riley!

nodes.text: I’ll guard every cent with my life—and with zero secrets between us from now on.

nodes.prompt: How do you honor Mom’s memory at the Sunday table?

options.label: Take a new family portrait together
options.player_reply_text: Everyone squeeze in beside Mom’s portrait—time for a brand-new chapter on the living-room wall.

options.label: Dedicate a scholarship in Mom & Claire’s name
options.player_reply_text: Let’s use the recovered interest to fund a scholarship in both Mom’s and Aunt Claire’s names!

nodes.text: WARM MEMORY: The shutter clicks on four bright smiles—a wound of ten years finally healed.
LASTING GRACE: Dad’s eyes fill with grateful tears as Grace hugs you tight.
Best recovery medicine in the world is an honest family. Take care, everyone!
Come grab a plate before the soup gets cold, Riley.

nodes.headline: FINALE · Truth Heals The House
nodes.teaser_text: You uncovered the truth behind the hospital bag, stopped the embezzler, and reunited your family.
